records.name: Super Afterimage
records.character_source: Bardock, Goku, and numerous customizable partners
records.skill_description: Creates multiple afterimages that allow the user to evade attacks or move behind a nearby opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 skill description permits movement during the afterimage sequence and slipping behind a nearby opponent. Independent documentation identifies it as an advanced Afterimage variation. Exact frames, invulnerability windows, and matchup behavior remain unpromoted.
records.acquisition_notes: The Future Warrior purchases Super Afterimage from the Conton City Skill Shop. Partner Customization can add it to additional character skillsets after the 1.09.00 update; this does not change CaC acquisition.
records.pve_notes: Skill Shop acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Its defensive/vanish behavior is documented, including use as a counter-like movement option. Exact frame data and matchup-specific behavior are not promoted to canonical numeric data.
